title: Check off each thing today: one big tap per thing, its streak, and how many are done today
about: Habits, medication, plants watered, chores, practice: anything done (or not) each day, used every day on a phone. Each thing (a row of one table) gets one big tap for today, its last days to fill in, and its streak; the top says how many are done today. A check is a row of another table, one per thing and day, its day as 'YYYY-MM-DD'; a tap adds or removes it. Use it for the screen people open every day; keep adding and editing the things on a second screen (or ADD for a quick add here).

table.about: the table of checks: one row per thing and day done

items.about: the table of the things to check off (habits, medicines, plants)

item.about: the column of the checks table that holds the thing's id

day.about: the column of the checks table that holds the day, 'YYYY-MM-DD'

key.about: names the pattern's data and state

name.about: the column of the things shown as each one's name

days.about: how many days each thing shows, today last (a phone shows yesterday and today)

itemWhere.about: an SQL condition on the things (such as active)

itemOrder.about: SQL ORDER BY for the things

add.about: true puts a quick add for a new thing under the list

noun.about: what one thing is, for the quick add

skip.about: a bool column of the checks table: with it, a thing can be skipped today (a Skip under its name); a skipped day keeps the streak without adding to it, and is not counted as to do

data.{{key}}_items: SELECT * FROM {{items}}{{itemWhere|pre: WHERE }} ORDER BY {{itemOrder}} LIMIT 300

body.name: {{name}}
body.empty: Nothing to check off yet. Add the first one below.

row.do: =async () => { const v = String(state.{{key}}_new || '').trim(); if (!v) return; await app.insert({{items|json}}, { [{{name|json}}]: v }); set({ {{key}}_new: '' }); }
